en.text: That car was his to begin with.

original: 私が太るのは、甘い物を沢山食べるからだ。

en.text: I'm starting to gain weight after eating so many sweet things.

original: この本は、100年以上前の物なんだ。

en.text: This book's over a hundred years old.

original: 私の物はないよ。

en.text: None of them are mine.

original: 「郵便物っていつ来る？」「普段は10時から12時ぐらいだけど、午後まで来ない時もあるね」

en.text: "When does the post come?" "Usually between 10 and 12 o'clock, but sometimes not until afternoon."
"When does the post come?" "Usually between 10 and 12 o'clock, but sometimes not until the afternoon."

original: 風が強くて洗濯物を干せない。

en.text: It's too windy to put the laundry out to dry.

en.text: Since then, he has already written several books and periodical short stories.

original: 不審物を見かけたら、ご連絡ください。

en.text: Let me know if you see something odd.
If you see anything suspicious, please contact us.

original: 何か読む物、持って行った方がいいかな？

en.text: Should I bring something to read?

original: 俺に物を投げるなよ。

en.text: Don't throw things at me.

original: この箱の中の物、欲しい？

en.text: Do you want what's in this box?

original: 君は相変わらず物を元の場所に戻さないね。

en.text: You never put things back where they belong.

original: 何か食べる物を持ってくればよかった。

en.text: I should've brought something to eat.

en.text: No child belongs to his parents.

original: 子供は親の所有物ではありません。

en.text: No child belongs to his parents.
No child belongs to their parents.

original: 洗濯物を乾かす時間だ。

en.text: It's time to dry the laundry.

en.text: I hate sweets, so I don't eat them!

en.text: Large residual stomach contents may lead to loss of appetite, nausea and vomiting.

en.text: The way things are said matter.

original: 私の物を売る権利はないよ。

en.text: You don't have the right to sell my stuff.

en.text: Is there anything else you want?
